units.source_text: 某精神病院第二十三号患者经常跟人讲这个故事。

en.t: Patient Number Twenty-three at a certain psychiatric hospital often tells people this story.

units.source_text: 这个疯子的年龄应该已经超过三十岁了，猛地一眼看上去却显得很年轻。

en.t: This madman must already be over thirty, yet at a quick glance he looks very young.

units.source_text: 他前半生的经历——不，先不讲这些事了。

en.t: As for the story of his earlier life - no, let us leave that aside for now.

units.source_text: 他一动不动的双手抱膝，不时的望向窗外（

en.t: He sat motionless with both hands clasped around his knees, now and then looking out the window (

units.source_text: 铁窗外，一棵掉光叶子的槲树，桠杈伸向正在酝酿着下雪的天空），

en.t: outside the barred window, a leafless oak stretched its branches toward a sky heavy with the promise of snow),

units.source_text: 絮叨的向院长S博士和我讲了这个故事。

en.t: he rambled on, telling this story to Director Dr. S and to me.

units.source_text: 当然了，他也不是纹丝不动的。

en.t: Of course, he was not perfectly still the whole time.

units.source_text: 比如，讲到“很是诧异”的时候，他就忽然往后仰了下脸……

en.t: For instance, when he came to the words "greatly astonished," he suddenly tilted his face backward...
